ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Stage 1 trains four out-of-fold specialist classifiers with zero catalogue-distance features (M_morph seamless 1m/10m geomorphology + chi; M_subsurf potential-field derivatives + Gallardo-Meju cross-gradients + depth persistence + strain/seismicity; M_hydro potassic K/Th + magnetite destruction + conductivity + 2m thermal probes/sinter/geothermometry; M_joint cover-adaptive multi-sensor interaction). Stage 2 extracts pure-physics steerable fault-topology operators strictly on OOF Stage-1 probability fields across 12 strikes and 3 length scales: 2nd-best independent sensor family corroboration, flank-suppressed steerable line persistence, bilateral Holocene wash bridge sqrt(P_ahead * P_behind), and en-echelon relay-ramp conjugate stepover bridge max_s sqrt(P_ahead,+s*delta * P_behind,-s*delta), followed by lazy-greedy exact 300 m submodular Tversky coverage allocation off-catalogue.
ranked_hypotheses.why_off_catalogue: USGS/INGENIOUS mapped continuous range-front scarps in 1m-LiDAR terrain, missing (a) faults segmented across active Holocene washes/fans, (b) 200-500 m dilatational relay ramps / stepover zones hosting >75% of blind Great Basin geothermal upflow (Faulds & Hinz 2015), and (c) structures in the ~40% non-LiDAR gap, while avoiding GEMSDOE68's live score collapse (0.0437) caused by catalogue-distance overfitting.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut shoreline benches and coalescing alluvial-fan apron channels (suppressed by elevation-contour / zero-subsurface-step / orthogonal cross-gradient features and multi-expert corroboration).
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Moderate (~4 min CPU, 0 external un-mirrored downloads needed)
